results.question: when does the marketplace go quiet during the year?
results.sql:
SELECT c.semester, c.period, c.year, c.day AS quiet_day
FROM nlq.calendar c
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON c.day = l.listed_on
WHERE l.status = 'removed'
  AND c.period IN ('move-in', 'move-out', 'winter break', 'summer break')
ORDER BY c.year, c.semester, c.period, c.day;
